name: Glabrezu

actions.name: Pincer
actions.effect: Target is grappled. Grappled Medium or smaller creatures are restrained.

actions.name: Power Word Stun
actions.effect: One creature with 25 HP or fewer is stunned for 1d4 rounds. No save. Usable once per encounter.

actions.name: Darkness
actions.effect: Creates a 9m radius sphere of magical darkness at a point within 18m. Lasts 1 minute.

reactions.name: Pincer Crush
reactions.effect: When a grappled creature attempts to escape, the Glabrezu crushes them for 4d8 bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Magic Resistance
reactions.effect: +2d6 to a save against a spell or magical effect.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: Can cast Confusion (2 actions, 9m radius, WILL save) once per encounter and Dispel Magic (1 action) at will.

traits.name: Treacherous
traits.desc: The Glabrezu is a master deceiver. It can telepathically communicate within 36m and offer mortals wishes in exchange for their souls.

lore: Glabrezus are cunning, four-armed demons that combine immense physical power with magical ability. Unlike most demons, they prefer seduction over slaughter, tempting mortals with wishes that inevitably lead to corruption and damnation.
